verdict.rationale: Spline is a design tool with a 2D canvas, so exporting production image assets is a fair question to ask of it. Its documented exports are web-oriented only: code exports (Vanilla JS, Three.js, React, Next.js, react-three-fiber), the spline-viewer web component, and a self-hosted ZIP of the runtime. Nothing in the evidence mentions PNG, SVG or PDF export, per-layer export presets, scale options or slices.
